comment: coloratt.c query_color() and query_attr() (PICK_ONE) return their default when the player toggles the preselected row off and commits (pick_cnt == 0); only ESC (-1) makes options.c's menu_colors handler skip add_menu_coloring_parsed(). 'O' opens the options menu, ':' searches for 'menu colors', 'a' adds the pattern 'dagger', and '-' (MENU_UNSELECT_ALL) then Return commits a cleared menu. Segment 1 clears 'no color' in the colour menu and picks bold (b); segment 2 picks red (b) and clears 'none' in the attribute menu. Each then shows the 'Do what?' menu, which lists the new colouring, and ESC leaves both menus.
